criteria_results.criterion_text: Constructing a `Runbook` with an empty `steps` tuple raises
criteria_results.evidence: Runbook.__post_init__ validation raises RunbookValidationError with message 'Runbook must have at least one step (ASSUM-002)' when steps tuple is empty. Test passes.

Runbook.__post_init__ validation checks 0 <= current_step_index <= len(steps)-1 and raises RunbookValidationError referencing ASSUM-004. Two tests verify negative index and beyond-range index both raise correctly.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Constructing a `Step` with an empty `step_type` raises
criteria_results.evidence: Step.__post_init__ validation checks step_type is non-empty (after strip) and raises RunbookValidationError with message referencing ASSUM-005. TestStepValidation.test_empty_step_type_raises_validation_error passes.

All dataclasses use @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True). TestRunbookConstruction.test_three_step_runbook_is_valid_and_comparable creates three-step runbook and verifies field values and equality comparison works.
